real_defects.issue: fisherRxCMonteCarlo shuffled one label per subject per sample (O(n x samples)) on the page's main thread: a 3x3 table of n=18,000 froze 13 s. Replaced by sequential hypergeometric cell draws (chop-down from the mode): 32 ms; 18 million in 0.3 s.
analyze() with paired data and alternative less/greater silently returned the two-sided McNemar p-value (the page offers that combination). Now warns in the summary and reports alternative two-sided.
A 2x2 with an empty row printed 'Group 1: NaN%' and 'Risk difference NaN points' (Boschloo p NaN beside Barnard p 1). Now refused with a message naming the empty group.
Stratified summary called an infinite Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio 'the strata confound the pooled table' (|log(crude/Infinity)| > log 1.25). Comparison now skipped when the common OR is 0 or infinite.
